verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms webhook-driven status updates (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) and an explicit /identity_verification/retry API endpoint, plus Dashboard-based status viewing, indicating a documented API-driven lifecycle exists. However the pack lacks explicit documentation/citations for create-session, get-status, retrieve-results/media, or cancel/redact API endpoints, relying instead on Dashboard actions (e.g., Override Result) for some lifecycle steps rather than pure API calls. missing for 10: explicit docs for /identity_verification/create, /get, /retrieve media, and /remove (redact) endpoints, and confirmation that cancel/redact is API-driven rather than dashboard-only.
